<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent1 "<!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Expanded Entity &ent3;">
  <!ENTITY ent3 "Nested Entity">
  %ent1;
  <?pi-target pi-data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2" ns2:attr="value">
  <!-- Comment containing CDATA-like markup <![CDATA[ test ]]> -->
  <child>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section with entities &ent2; and tags <foo> ]]>
  </child>
  <ns2:child>&ent2;</ns2:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (sec)*>
  <!ELEMENT sec (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY gen 'General Parameterized Entity'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub">
  <!-- Top comment for processing instructions & entities -->
  <sub:sec sub:id="1">
    <?target data="processing instruction content"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA payload with <tags> and &gen; references.
    ]]>
    &gen;
  </sub:sec>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; &base; &base;">
  <?catalog-control mode="strict"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment block explaining the catalog -->
  <item id="i1" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block 1: <item id="i1"> &complex; </item>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item id="i2">&complex;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, body)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "Beta &ent-a;">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction test="value"?>
<document xmlns="http://ns.example.com/doc" xmlns:m="http://ns.example.com/m">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <header>Initial Header</header>
  <!-- Body comment with CDATA -->
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment inside CDATA -->
      Data: &ent-b;
    ]]>
  </body>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Entity 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Entity 2 &e1;">
  <!ENTITY e3 "Entity 3 &e2;">
  <!NOTATION n SYSTEM "sys">
  <!ENTITY ent-sys SYSTEM "uri:test" NDATA n>
  <?xml-debug level="high"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/root" xmlns:foo="http://example.com/foo">
  <!-- Comment 1 -->
  <foo:node>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing entity reference &e3; directly.
    ]]>
  </foo:node>
  <node>&e3;</node>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ENTITY shared 'SharedValue'>">
  %macro;
  <?archive-meta version="2.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta">
  <!-- Archive comment detailing layout -->
  <meta:file meta:id="f1">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive payload data with &shared; and <xml> fragments.
    ]]>
  </meta:file>
  <file>&shared;</file>
</archive>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (testcase*)>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pass "SUCCESS">
  <!ENTITY fail "FAILURE">
  <!ENTITY result "&pass; or &fail;">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="test.css"?>
]>
<testsuite xmlns="http://qa.org/schema" xmlns:tr="http://qa.org/tracking">
  <!-- Testsuite tracking comment -->
  <tr:testcase tr:id="TC001">
    <![CDATA[
      Result status check: &result;
    ]]>
  </tr:testcase>
  <testcase>&result;</testcase>
</testsuite>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY val "Enabled">
  <!ENTITY % ext-pe "<!-- Parameter entity comment -->">
  %ext-pe;
  <?config-engine name="v1"?>
]>
<config xmlns="http://config.org" xmlns:env="http://config.org/env">
  <!-- Configuration file comment block -->
  <env:setting env:name="mode">
    <![CDATA[
      Setting value is &val; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </env:setting>
  <setting>&val;</setting>
</config>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entX "ValX">
  <!ENTITY entY "ValY &entX;">
  <!NOTATION jpeg SYSTEM "image/jpeg">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.jpg" NDATA jpeg>
  <?container-exec cmd="init"?>
]>
<container xmlns="http://container.org/ns" xmlns:opt="http://container.org/opt">
  <!-- Comment before options -->
  <opt:item opt:code="001">
    <![CDATA[
      Processing CDATA with entities &entY; and unparsed entity references.
    ]]>
  </opt:item>
  <item>&entY;</item>
</container>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY book-title "XML Parsing &author;">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <?library-system status="active"?>
]>
<library xmlns="http://library.org" xmlns:pub="http://library.org/pub">
  <!-- Library inventory comment -->
  <pub:book pub:isbn="123456789">
    <![CDATA[
      Book info CDATA: &book-title;
    ]]>
  </pub:book>
  <book>&book-title;</book>
</library>
